conflicts.detail: The Brand Concierge FAQ says it 'builds in data residency, so personal data collected during a conversation' stays local, while the March 2026 security overview says all components and Azure OpenAI calls run in US-East.

The FAQ says the AI is 'specifically trained on your organization's content and customer data'; the security overview says Adobe does not use customer data to train Brand Concierge or its components. The FAQ reads as grounding on customer content, not model training, but RFP answers should quote the security overview.

The standalone AEM Sites 99.99% SLA license includes Edge Delivery Services, but the same product description says Additional Publish Regions do not extend to Edge Delivery Services. EDS docs say EDS has the same SLA as AEM as a Cloud Service and runs on two redundant CDNs.

A web search summary cited an older AEM Forms page saying Edge Delivery forms could not connect to Marketo and the connector was early access. The current pages (updated Oct 9 2026) list Submit to Marketo Engage for Universal Editor forms via AEM Publish. The older statement was not found on any live page.

The SaaS vs PaaS comparison gives SaaS 99.9% infrastructure and application, while the PaaS column (and the unverified Actionability Addendum) gives 99.99% infrastructure. Different products, so answer per deployment model.
The Workfront Coworker overview says Coworker is not currently available to health care, finance and some other sensitive-data industries. Matters for FSI RFPs.

notes: No prices are recorded. Product description dates are the effective dates shown on each page.
Hosts not reachable: www.adobe.com (SLAs, Trust Center, security overview PDFs), status.adobe.com, www.workfront.com.
Status 'verified' means the quote was read on the page this session and machine-checked against the saved page text.
